title: Mission Destinations and Planetary Reference Profiles

destinations.name: Moon - Shackleton Crater Rim (South Pole)
destinations.name_zh: 月球 · 沙克尔顿环形山边缘（南极）
destinations.atmosphere_composition: Near-vacuum (<10^-12 kPa); traces of helium, neon, hydrogen
destinations.description: The Artemis Base Camp location. High-elevation crater rims experience long periods of sunlight, while permanently shadowed crater floors trap ancient water ice.
destinations.citation: NASA (2022). NASA Identifies Candidate Regions for Landing Next Americans on the Moon.

destinations.name: Mars - Jezero Crater
destinations.name_zh: 火星 · 耶泽罗撞击坑（毅力号着陆区）
destinations.hazard: Global Dust Storms (blocking solar generation for up to 60 sols)
destinations.description: An ancient river delta explored by the Perseverance rover. Thin carbon dioxide atmosphere allows MOXIE oxygen generation, but seasonal dust storms demand nuclear or long-term energy storage.
destinations.citation: NASA Science: Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover Mission & Mars Facts.

destinations.name: Venus - Cloud City (50 km Altitude)
destinations.name_zh: 金星 · 高空云层飞艇栖息地（科研概念）
destinations.concept_label: NASA Research Concept / 概念探索
destinations.atmosphere_composition: 96.5% Carbon Dioxide, 3.5% Nitrogen with sulfuric acid aerosol clouds
destinations.description: At 50 km above the superheated Venusian surface (465°C, 92 atm), temperature and atmospheric pressure are remarkably Earth-like. Breathable air acts as a lifting gas.
destinations.citation: Arney, D. & Jones, C. (2015). High Altitude Venus Operational Concept (HAVOC). NASA NTRS 20160006329.

destinations.name: Jupiter Moon: Europa - Subsurface Ocean Base
destinations.name_zh: 木卫二 · 欧罗巴冰下海洋考察站（科研概念）
destinations.concept_label: NASA Research Concept / 概念探索
destinations.radiation_hazard: Extreme Jovian magnetospheric radiation belt (~5400 mSv/day on surface)
destinations.description: Underneath a 15-25 km ice crust lies a global saltwater ocean with twice the volume of Earth's oceans combined. Investigated by the Europa Clipper mission.
destinations.citation: NASA Europa Clipper Mission & Outer Planets Assessment Group.
